answer: Auction 1,000 identity slots per epoch. Applicants bid locked POA; the top 1,000 pay the clearing price, minimum 100 POA. A relic identity cannot re-enter without a fresh winning bid, so dead fakes stay dead. Each extra fake must outbid honest agents, driving the clearing price up in a spiral: ten fakes cost ten times the price, a hundred raise the price itself. Losing bids return at the jetty of the next epoch.
